high_level_description: The image is a meme that combines text with an illustration to convey a message about the founding of the United States. The text at the top reads: "Never forget:" followed by a statement: "The people who founded this country were cannabis growing, whiskey drinking, tax evading 'domestic terrorists' who shot at cops and tar and feathered lawmakers who got out of line." Below the text is an illustration depicting a historical scene. The setting appears to be a colonial-era town, possibly during the American Revolution, given the attire and activities of the individuals.
